Excellent roundtable discussion at #HLPF2024 on a Just Energy Transition in a SIDS Context, organized by the government of Comoros. 🇰🇲  I emphasized the opportunities to overcome existing challenges that hinder sustainable energy adoption in #SIDS 🏝️through innovative solutions:

- Utilizing innovative finance mechanisms, including thematic bonds, and Debt-for-Energy transactions, to provide effective financing for SIDS' just energy transition
- Enhancing policy, de-risking mechanisms and regulatory frameworks to promote greater uptake of renewables
- Connecting renewables with green and blue economies to support economic diversification
- Harnessing digital technologies and AI to develop informed energy resilience strategies and optimize off-grid solutions, transforming SIDS into 'digital islands’ 🏝️
- Creating an ecosystem enabling active private sector participation to boost renewable energy capacity, job creation & technology transfer

Energy is pivotal in achieving the ambitious goals of the ABAS declaration. As a key partner of SIDS, UNDP's approach goes beyond conventional project development and aims at amplifying exponentially the impact of sustainable energy systems transformation on the ground to actualize these outcomes – our strategy is not just about providing energy; it’s about catalyzing #EnergyForDevelopment. ⚡️
